prompt: Photorealistic cinematic live-action still, horizontal 16:9 landscape composition rendered at 1344x768, wide frame, never vertical or portrait. A medium shot inside a cozy vintage bedroom, wooden slatted-headboard bed centered against the far wall, window with sheer curtains and potted plants on the left, bookshelf on the right, patterned rug, warm morning light. The exact same camera position and bed framing as the start of the pull. Now two people have both sunk down side by side into the rumpled duvet. One is the same single East Asian Chinese man, about 28 years old, oval face, smooth fair skin, calm gentle almond eyes, straight eyebrows, soft short neatly-cut black hair with a natural side part (NOT a buzz cut, not spiky), clean-shaven; he wears a DEEP NAVY BLUE plain crew-neck short-sleeve tee and matching deep navy home pants (navy on navy, no grey and no other color). Beside him is the same single East Asian Chinese woman, about 26 years old, shoulder-length slightly wavy tousled just-woke-up messy bed hair, round soft youthful face, cute sleepy playful vibe, wearing an oversized loose light-grey boyfriend-style sleep tee and sleep shorts (she stays fully dressed in her sleepwear). The man has just been dragged in under the covers and the two of them lie close together; the duvet is pulled up high over most of their bodies so that only their two heads stick out above the covers, and they nestle together cheek to cheek, laughing and playing, the man half-resigned and amused, the woman triumphant. Under the blanket the woman has playfully hooked one of her legs across the man to tangle him in place, but that leg stays completely under the duvet and hidden beneath the covers; there is absolutely no bare leg and no exposed limb sticking out on top of the blanket, the smooth duvet stays draped over their bodies with nothing poking out. The medium framing holds both people and the whole bed so this reads as the landing of the pull, clearly changed from the start. Warm golden high-saturation soft morning light, cozy nostalgic memory mood, gentle dust motes in the sunbeams. Photorealistic surfaces and fabric textures, medium shot, shot on a full-frame cinema camera with a 50mm lens. Not an illustration, not anime, not a 3D render, no cartoon stylization. no text, no subtitles, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no Chinese characters, no pinyin anywhere in the image.
